books.title: The Little Prince
books.description: The Little Prince (French: Le Petit Prince, pronounced [lə p(ə)ti pʁɛ̃s]) is a novella written and illustrated by French writer and aviator Antoine de Saint-Exupéry. It was first published in English and French in the United States by Reynal & Hitchcock in April 1943 and was published posthumously in France following liberation; Saint-Exupéry's works had been banned by the Vichy Regime. The story follows a young prince who visits various planets, including Earth, and addresses themes of loneliness, friendship, love, and loss. Despite its style as a children's book, The Little Prince makes observations about life, adults, and human nature.

books.description: 专为3-6岁幼儿设计的英语启蒙播客！ 每集3-5分钟的温馨小故事，通过可爱的动物角色和简单的日常场景，让孩子在轻松愉快的氛围中自然习得英语。 特色： • 简单重复的词汇，适合磨耳朵 • 温暖治愈的故事主题 • AI原声配音，发音标准清晰 • 每集附带词汇复习环节 适合： • 3-6岁英语启蒙 • 亲子共听 • 睡前故事时间 • 英语磨耳朵 更新：每周一、周二各更新1集 FluentFox - 让英语学习像听故事一样简单
